propers.name: Introit
propers.text:
Mihi autem nimis honorati sunt amici tui, Deus: nimis confortatus est
principatus eorum. Domine, probasti me, et cognovisti me: tu cognovisti
sessionem meam et resurrectionem meam. V. Gloria Patri.

provenance.locator: editorial-projection artifact physical lines 378-380; antecedent Mame Tours 1922, printed p. 498; artifact PDF p. 612
provenance.provenance_authority: Triptych editorial projection verified by page-image collation against the 1962 target edition
provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: antecedent witness is the Mame, Tours 1922 (editio quarta iuxta typicam Vaticanam); 95% of the 1962 body's tokens align in order after canon folding; the witness text layer damages 'qu sumus' where the 1962 prints 'quaesumus'; the Mame prints j where the 1962 prints i (Iesum/Jesum, eius/ejus) and its recogniser renders the ae ligature as 'z' or 'e'; both are orthographic; pointing: the antecedent's reading is recorded verbatim above so its commas and colons can be compared, but its punctuation is NOT safely collatable - the recogniser turns commas into full stops, semicolons and question marks - so no punctuation difference here should be read as a difference between the printings; the 1962 prints the conclusion as 'Per Dominum.'; conclusion length was excluded from the alignment and is recorded here as printed, per the settled rule. Corroboration: Pustet 1862 text-layer lines 54718-54724 (75% coverage); Benziger 1962 conformed printing at line 65292 (65%; comparison only, never a publication basis).

gloriari: ut ejus semper et patrociniis sublevemur; et fidem congrua
devotione sectemur. Per Dominum.
